paras: Application: Nissan R35 GT-R Part Type: In-tank fuel pump hanger (pumps not included) Part Number: 20-0572

The Radium Engineering R35 GT-R Fuel Hanger is a drop-in replacement for the factory in-tank fuel pump unit, holding up to three 39mm aftermarket pumps (brushed or brushless) with no permanent vehicle modifications. The pumps feed an anodised aluminium collector box that stays full to prevent fuel starvation during aggressive driving, and the hanger is compatible with alternative fuels such as methanol, ethanol and E85.
hl: Drop-In Replacement: Replaces the OEM in-tank pump unit
1-3 Pumps: Accepts up to three 39mm brushed or brushless pumps
Fuel Starvation Protection: Collector box with three integrated one-way fill valves (1065 LPH total)
Venturi Rerouting: Retains venturi function without restricting regulator return
Ports: 10AN ORB outlet and 8AN ORB return, each with 6AN male adapter
High-Current Electrics: Anti-rotation stainless studs and sealed connections
ft: Radium Engineering Fuel Pump Hanger for Nissan GT-R R35
